svg.font-family: "STIX Two Text", "Latin Modern Roman", "Times New Roman", Times, serif
svg.title: Microstrip line on a dispersive substrate
svg.desc: Section along a PEC strip and ground plane of equal width on a thin dispersive substrate, in an air box with absorbing faces and a wave port at each end; the cross-section at a port plane with the electric field between the plates and around their edges; and the real and imaginary parts of the Djordjevic-Sarkar permittivity against frequency on a logarithmic axis.
svg.text: Section along the line (not to scale)
Cross-section at a port plane (not to scale)
